elements_selected.content: Implement terminal color capability detection and the bridge color palette. Detect capability from environment: (1) NO_COLOR set or TERM=dumb → no-color mode; (2) COLORTERM=truecolor or COLORTERM=24bit → true-color; (3) TERM=xterm-256color or similar → 256-color; (4) fallback → 8-color ANSI. Provide a LinkColor type that wraps ratatui::style::Color and cycles through a palette of 8 visually distinct colors (using ANSI colors in 8-color mode, RGB values in true-color mode). Provide a LinkColors struct that assigns LinkColor values to link ordinals 1..N, cycling on overflow. Expose a no_color() predicate. NFR-025, ADR-017.
